prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one finished wide landscape website product-card artwork for Price Reader, a Discord bot feature that scans uploaded images using OCR to recognize Discord Shop prices and match them to a configured shop price list.
Input image: supplied Review Credit artwork is a STYLE AND CHARACTER REFERENCE ONLY. Match its exact premium 3D series: the friendly white ceramic floating bot head, glossy obsidian face, two glowing blurple rounded-square eyes, circular refractive lavender glass platform, recognizable white Discord Clyde emblem on round blurple enamel badge on front of platform, tiny green status light, airy pearl-white studio, three-quarter camera angle, realistic materials, scale and sophisticated lighting. Replace ALL review imagery completely.
Primary request: a beautiful elegant artwork clearly showing a Discord bot SCANNING AN IMAGE TO READ A PRICE. No written text or numbers anywhere.
Subject/composition: one familiar floating bot head center-right, looking toward the feature objects on center-left. Center-left floats one upright rounded white ceramic image tile, slightly tilted in perspective; its face has a simple raised lavender landscape picture pictogram with two mountain triangles and a little circular sun, indicating an uploaded image without showing an actual screenshot. A large sophisticated magnifying glass overlaps the lower-right portion of this tile: brushed silver rim, satin Discord-blurple handle, physically clear pale-blue optical glass with subtle realistic magnification. Within the area examined by the magnifier, a beautiful small mint-green price tag silhouette with a circular punched hole is crisply highlighted by four delicate violet scanning-corner brackets. The price tag contains NO writing, numbers, currency signs or other markings. A single fine translucent cyan scan line runs horizontally across the image tile, communicating OCR. Keep the mountain pictogram secondary to the magnifier and price tag. The magnifier, image tile and blank tag must create a simple unmistakable single symbol cluster. Do not add coins or money piles. The bot eyes and Discord badge remain fully unobscured.
Platform: one shared circular clear lavender glass plinth with round blurple badge centered on its front face, containing the correct recognizable white Discord Clyde emblem with two round eye cutouts, plus one tiny green status LED beside badge.
Style/medium: exceptionally polished luxury CGI product campaign art. White porcelain ceramic, brushed silver, satin blurple #5865F2, precise lavender-glass refraction, clear optical lens, restrained mint/cyan scan accent. Soft broad studio light from upper left, tasteful lilac rim light, realistic delicate shadows, controlled highlights, no heavy bloom. Seamless near-white to very pale lavender studio and softly reflective matte floor. Consistent with supplied reference, beautiful professional 3D product illustration readable at thumbnail scale.
Framing: wide 16:9 approximately 1672x941 or higher, centered balanced sculptural composition, main feature cluster left and bot right above the shared plinth, full objects inside central 80% with generous safe margins. Quiet upper-left corner for website overlay badge. No typography column.
Constraints: one bot, one image tile, one magnifying glass, one blank price tag, one platform and Discord badge. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, currency symbols, pseudo-text, labels, words, UI screenshots, watermarks, card frames or outer borders. The only branding is Discord Clyde. No review hearts, stars, speech bubbles, headphones, shop storefronts, wallets, coins, credit cards, charts, receipts with text, server hardware, humans, hands or robot limbs. No clutter or excessive neon. Render actual finished artwork, not a website mockup.
